hero_description: A comparison tool for classical texts and manuscripts compatible with IIIF manifests. Compare using three modes: side-by-side image viewing, character-level diff highlighting, and edit distance network visualization.
feature_image_desc: High-resolution side-by-side image viewing with OpenSeadragon. Zoom and pan for detailed examination.
feature_diff_desc: Character-level diff highlighting. Additions and deletions are immediately visible.
feature_lev_desc: Line-by-line similarity via Levenshtein distance, visualized as a network graph.
label: Label
exp_network: Calculates string similarity using edit distance. The top 10 edges that exceed the threshold are displayed.
how_to_use_desc: Enter two IIIF manifest URLs and click "Start Comparing". Each manifest should contain images and text annotations.
